description.value: Royal Seoul House is a Korean BBQ restaurant that has been serving authentic Korean cuisine on Vancouver's West Broadway since 1990. Diners cook marinated meats such as bulgogi and galbi on gas or charcoal grills built directly into the tables, making for an interactive, communal meal. Situated on a major cycling corridor in Vancouver, it offers a substantial sit-down dining option for cyclists passing through the area.
